ai_analysis.summary: The post recommends 15 linked case studies as a way to learn system design in one month or less. The titles cover scalability, cache consistency, storage durability, real-time leaderboards, driver discovery, ETA computation, distributed counters, database scale, API idempotency, load balancing, and application architectures. Except for headline figures in some titles, the post does not explain the designs or provide enough information to evaluate their implementations.
